method: v71, every voter modeled on the whole profile: real respondents raked to each county on its 2024 presidential vote, outlook, race, age, education and news source, each voting by every question, social media use, shows and news against every candidate position and each polled candidate pull; no 2026 result sets a county; v70: each county is its modeled voters by 2026 vote group, 2024 vote, outlook, news source and region, each voting and turning out by the all question model for each pairing, anchored to the county 2024 presidential result; v68: every pairing modeled on every question: a vote model fit on 36,946 real head to head answers from 19 matchups, each respondent described by all 632 usable questions in the ALL POLLS FILLED package and each candidate by researched positions on fifteen live issues, held out accuracy 93 to 95 percent; pairings no one polled move from the nearest measured pairing by the model difference, carried to every county through 2026 vote group, outlook, 2024 vote and region cells; turnout unique to each pairing from how strongly each voter prefers one side; the 19 measured pairings stay on the county question estimates, county 2024 result plus survey swing.
